children: Scholar Rock announced FDA approval of ISEMBYLD for SMA in patients ≥2 years on an SMN2-targeted therapy and is beginning U.S. commercial launch.
FDA approved ISEMBYLD (apitegromab-mstn) for adults and children ≥2 years receiving an SMN2-targeted treatment.
Phase 3 SAPPHIRE: ISEMBYLD 10 mg/kg showed a 2.2-point HFMSE improvement vs. placebo (nominal p=0.0121), indicating clinically meaningful motor gains.
34.2% of ISEMBYLD patients had ≥3-point HFMSE gains vs. 13.5% on placebo (odds ratio 3.8; nominal p=0.0125).
U.S. commercial launch underway with product available to ship in coming days and Scholar Rock Supports patient assistance program active.
Company awarded a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher and reports $492M cash and liquidity as of June 30, 2026.
